verdict.rationale: Composio provides key pieces for background automation. Triggers fire on events in connected apps (new Slack message, GitHub commit, incoming email) and POST signed payloads to a registered webhook. Credentials are stored and refreshed per user, so agents can keep acting without re-auth, and `composio login --agent` allows browserless sign-in. However, the evidence shows no built-in scheduler or hosted runner for autonomous jobs: the user must host their own webhook receiver and agent loop to act on events. Missing for 10: hosted or scheduled execution of automations (cron or recurring runs), a first-party background agent runtime or workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration of trigger-driven autonomous runs.
